prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Welcome Back to Your Desktop Pet", "Log into your existing account to restore your saved pets, or create a new account to start fresh.", "Sign In to Restore Existing Pet", "Create New Account"]
1: ["Select your favorite species and view style variations on the next screen.", "Preview Pet Styles", "Check out how your desktop pet will look under different artistic themes.", "Continue to Adoption"]
2: ["Crafting Your Desktop Companion...", "We are generating custom animations and desktop behaviors for your pet.", "Building 3D Model & Behaviors"]
3: ["Learn Controls", "Quick Desktop Controls", "Right-click your pet anytime to open controls, send messages, or send them to sleep in the system tray.", "Right-click pet for menu | Double-click to talk | Drag to move across monitors", "Launch Pet to Desktop"]
4: ["Select Your Adoption Journey", "Choose premade companion designs for instant setup or build a fully custom pet.", "Instant Companions vs Custom Created Pets"]
5: ["Upload Pet Reference Photos", "High-contrast front-facing photos yield the best 3D pet model results.", "Choose Front Photo", "Lighting & Angle Check: Good"]
6: ["Sign In to Access Your Saved Pets", "Please use the exact same login provider you used previously so your pet data syncs correctly.", "Using a new email creates a blank profile without your existing pet."]
7: ["We will notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet is ready to play!"]
8: ["Your Pet is Ready for Your Desktop!", "Complete these quick steps to get familiar with your companion:", "1. Drag pet across screen | 2. Try pet voice command | 3. Pin to taskbar", "Start Playing"]
9: ["Next up: Choose whether to adopt a classic pet or create your custom companion!", "Welcome to your desktop pet setup. In just a few quick steps, your new digital companion will be roaming your desktop."]
